en.metadata.name: Access Control
en.metadata.description: Manage access Keys, protected routes, and the route and model scope for each Key.
en.ui.inactive: The plugin is disabled; Keys are read-only. Enable it to manage Keys and route protection.
en.ui.configurationPending: Configuration saved; publication is still pending.
en.ui.expirationFuture: The expiration time must be later than now.
en.ui.legacySecret: This legacy Key only stores a digest, so its plaintext cannot be viewed. It still works; create a replacement if it is lost.
en.ui.secretFailed: Unable to read the Key. Please try again later.
en.ui.deletedRouteError: The allowed list contains deleted routes. Remove them before saving.
en.ui.keyRoutesPending: Allowed routes saved, but publication is still pending.
en.ui.createdPending: Key created and saved, but publication is still pending. Allowed routes have not been configured. Save the plaintext, then edit this Key after publication recovers to finish setup.
en.ui.policyPublished: Key permissions saved and published. Route public access stays unchanged.
en.ui.routeHelp: Manage access to Bungee Routes. Public routes need no credentials; protected routes only accept valid, authorized Keys. Deleting a Key does not make routes public.
en.ui.deleteHelp: After deletion, this Key cannot start new requests; accepted requests continue. Route public access stays unchanged.
en.ui.allRoutesHelp: Allow access to current and future routes. Route public access stays unchanged.
en.ui.keyHelp: Keys provide access to routes that require them. Public routes need no credentials.
en.ui.allowedRoutesHelp: Select the Bungee routes that this Key can call. This does not change public access.
en.ui.modelsHelp: Supports * wildcards and is case-sensitive. Validation uses the model actually sent upstream.
en.ui.editHelp: Change the name, expiration, and access permissions. Removing authorization does not make routes public.
en.ui.noRoutesSelected: No routes selected: this Key has no access to protected routes yet.
en.ui.createHelp: Assign credentials to an app. You can view the Key from the list at any time.
en.ui.applyHelp: Allow this Key to call the route while preserving its other permissions and the route’s public access setting.
en.ui.notReady: The plugin is not ready or configuration is pending publication. Refresh the runtime status.
en.ui.allowedModels: Allowed models (one per line; leave blank to allow all)
en.ui.createRoutesFirst: No routes yet. Create one in route management first.
en.ui.noUsableKeys: No Keys available to configure. Create one first.
en.ui.viewHelp: Copy this Key for use in your app.
en.ui.name: Name
en.ui.keyNameExists: An API Key with this name already exists. Use another name.
en.ui.persistedPending: Configuration saved, but publication is still pending. Refresh the runtime status and confirm it has taken effect before continuing.
en.ui.createdPublic: Key created; allowed routes saved and published. Public routes remain public.
en.ui.createdIncomplete: Key created. {stage} is incomplete: {reason} Save the plaintext, then edit this Key to finish setup.
en.ui.clipboardUnavailable: Clipboard unavailable. Copy the plaintext manually.
en.ui.publicationPending: Saved; publication is still pending. Refresh the runtime status.
en.ui.invalidName: The name must contain 1–128 characters and no control characters.
en.ui.keyNotFound: This Key was not found. Refresh the list.
en.ui.invalidReferences: A route or Key reference is invalid. Refresh and try again.
en.ui.invalidRoutes: Route protection settings are invalid. Refresh and try again.
en.ui.invalidBinding: The route and Key binding is invalid. Refresh and try again.
en.ui.validationUnavailable: Route permission validation is unavailable. Try again later.
en.ui.invalidWrite: The submitted settings are invalid. Check them and try again.

zh-CN.metadata.name: 访问控制
zh-CN.metadata.description: 管理访问 Key、受保护路由和每个 Key 的路由及模型范围。
zh-CN.ui.configureDescription: 为路由 {path} 配置访问凭证。
zh-CN.ui.inactive: 插件已停用，Key 只读。启用插件后可管理 Key 与路由保护。
zh-CN.ui.configurationPending: 配置已保存，当前发布尚未完成。
zh-CN.ui.expirationFuture: 到期时间必须晚于当前时间。
zh-CN.ui.legacySecret: 此旧 Key 仅保存了摘要，无法查看明文。它仍可使用；如已遗失，请创建新 Key 替换。
zh-CN.ui.secretFailed: 无法读取 Key，请稍后重试。
zh-CN.ui.deletedRouteError: 允许列表包含已删除的路由，请移除后保存。
zh-CN.ui.keyRoutesPending: Key 允许路由已保存，但发布尚未完成。
zh-CN.ui.createdPending: Key 已创建并保存，发布尚未完成；允许路由尚未配置。请保存明文，发布恢复后编辑此 Key 完成设置。
zh-CN.ui.policyPublished: Key 权限已保存并发布，路由公开状态保持不变。
zh-CN.ui.routeHelp: 管理 Bungee Route 的访问方式。公开路由无需凭证；需要 Key 的路由只接受有效且获授权的 Key。删除 Key 不会让路由变为公开。
zh-CN.ui.deleteHelp: 删除后此 Key 无法再发起新请求，已接纳的请求继续。路由的公开状态保持不变。
zh-CN.ui.allRoutesHelp: 包含当前和后续新增路由的访问权限，路由公开状态保持不变。
zh-CN.ui.keyHelp: Key 用于访问需要 Key 的路由。公开路由无需凭证。
zh-CN.ui.allowedRoutesHelp: 从 Bungee 路由中选择此 Key 可以调用的入口，不改变路由的公开状态。
zh-CN.ui.modelsHelp: 支持 * 通配符，区分大小写；按实际发往上游的模型校验。
zh-CN.ui.editHelp: 修改名称、有效期和访问权限。取消授权不会将路由改为公开。
zh-CN.ui.noRoutesSelected: 未选择路由：此 Key 暂无受保护路由的访问权限。
zh-CN.ui.createHelp: 为应用分配调用凭证。可在列表中随时查看 Key。
zh-CN.ui.applyHelp: 允许此 Key 调用当前路由，保留其他权限和路由的公开状态。
zh-CN.ui.notReady: 插件尚未就绪或配置待发布；请刷新运行状态。
zh-CN.ui.allowedModels: 允许模型（每行一个，留空允许全部）
zh-CN.ui.createRoutesFirst: 尚无路由，请先在路由管理中创建。
zh-CN.ui.noUsableKeys: 暂无可配置的 Key，请先新建。
zh-CN.ui.name: 名称
zh-CN.ui.keyNameExists: API Key 名称已存在，请使用其他名称。
zh-CN.ui.persistedPending: 配置已保存，但发布尚未完成。请刷新运行状态，确认生效后继续。
zh-CN.ui.createdPublic: Key 已创建，允许路由已保存并发布。公开路由保持公开。
zh-CN.ui.createdIncomplete: Key 已创建。{stage}未完成：{reason} 请保存明文，随后编辑此 Key 完成设置。
zh-CN.ui.clipboardUnavailable: 剪贴板不可用，请手动复制明文。
zh-CN.ui.publicationPending: 已保存，发布尚未完成；请刷新运行状态。
zh-CN.ui.invalidName: 名称必须为 1–128 个字符，且不能包含控制字符。
zh-CN.ui.keyNotFound: 找不到此 Key，请刷新列表。
zh-CN.ui.invalidReferences: 路由或 Key 引用无效，请刷新后重试。
zh-CN.ui.invalidRoutes: 路由保护设置无效，请刷新后重试。
zh-CN.ui.invalidBinding: 路由与 Key 的关联设置无效，请刷新后重试。
zh-CN.ui.validationUnavailable: 暂时无法校验路由权限，请稍后重试。
zh-CN.ui.invalidWrite: 提交的设置无效，请检查后重试。
